title: Migrate H2 messaging, scheduling, and bridges to Fleet events
description: Move H2 message delivery, scheduling observation, activity, and bridge integrations onto Burrito Fleet message/event/plugin contracts without H2-specific Burrito behavior. Exact homes: internal/session/message/, internal/automation/, internal/activitylog/, internal/bridge/, internal/bridgeservice/, and tests/. Tests roll into make test; external flow fixtures roll into make test-external.
